title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani rejects Anbu but joins a family dinner. Unable to eat due to pregnancy, she faces Pavithra's questioning, yet Anbu still steps in to help when she vomits.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Paraman frames Ranjitham over the temple Pooja with Ilamathi, enraging Kalamma. Elsewhere, Leelavathi ousts Kumaresan and Gandhimathi after the house registration.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: With Pulikkutti's help, Vetri builds a small hut outside Shanmugam's house. The tailor shop owner demands that Shanmugam vacate the premises immediately, leaving him helpless.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Poongodi initially tells the police that Mayandi and Meenatchi harassed her. However, she later changes her statement, leaving everyone stunned.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Suresh becomes curious to check Mathi's messages after Bagyaraj reveals their group chat teasing. Meanwhile, Mathi tends to Lakshmi as she suffers from a severe headache.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Pandian worries over Saravanan's divorce hearing and scolds Senthil for sleeping. Bhagyam urges Thangamayil to demand alimony from Saravanan, while his brothers try to cheer him.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Fearing Karthika may disrupt Cheran's wedding, Pandian secures her promise not to interfere. Later, Cheran gifts Chandayatha a silver anklet and shares his happiness with her.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
episodeTitle: Muthu Unveils His New Business Plan
description: Muthu plans low-cost school transport for underprivileged children and tells his family about launching a new travel office. Manoj is delighted by Rohini's consent to divorce.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Eshwari and Chithra bring ear-piercing expense estimates to Tamizhselvi, who agrees to pay her share. Aishwarya hands over Sethupathi's cheque by demanding strict accounts.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Saranya praises Kasthuri's cooking. Later, hurt by Karikalan's mother, Kasthuri finds solace in Karthik and offers care to him and Saranya.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Sarasu appreciates Indhira for preparing her children for school and helping with chores. Indhira explains to Kandhasamy how the lack of digital payments may affect the mess.

title: Bigg Boss The Common Man
description: The Court Task gets intense as Muniyamma, Raju and Saranya make their cases, while Samyuktha and Divya face emotional twists amid a tense card selection.
